---
title: "API Reference"
---

Complete reference for all exported SpectraWeaveR functions, grouped by module.

## Utilities

Core format conversion, FCS I/O, and channel classification helpers.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_io_read_fcs()`](utils.qmd#sw_io_read_fcs) | Read FCS files with Aurora-safe defaults |
| [`sw_io_ff_to_tibble()`](utils.qmd#sw_io_ff_to_tibble) | Convert flowFrame to tibble |
| [`sw_io_tibble_to_ff()`](utils.qmd#sw_io_tibble_to_ff) | Convert tibble to flowFrame |
| [`sw_io_exprs_to_tibble()`](utils.qmd#sw_io_exprs_to_tibble) | Convert expression matrix to tibble |
| [`sw_channel_get_fluor()`](utils.qmd#sw_channel_get_fluor) | Get fluorescent channel names |
| [`sw_channel_set_markers()`](utils.qmd#sw_channel_set_markers) | Set marker names on a flowFrame |
| [`sw_channel_is_signal()`](utils.qmd#sw_channel_is_signal) | Identify signal columns |
| [`sw_channel_is_fluor()`](utils.qmd#sw_channel_is_fluor) | Identify fluorochrome columns |
| [`sw_io_subsample()`](utils.qmd#sw_io_subsample) | Aggregate and subsample flow frames |
| [`sw_io_event_audit()`](utils.qmd#sw_io_event_audit) | Collect events retained at each step |

## Spectral unmixing

AutoSpectral-based spectral unmixing workflow — six functions from step-by-step
control to a one-call orchestrator.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_unmix_setup()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix_setup) | Initialize AutoSpectral parameters |
| [`sw_unmix_prepare()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix_prepare) | Gate, clean, and extract fluorophore spectra |
| [`sw_unmix_extract_af()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix_extract_af) | Extract per-cell autofluorescence spectra |
| [`sw_unmix_extract_variants()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix_extract_variants) | Extract spectral variants |
| [`sw_unmix_run()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix_run) | Unmix spectral flow cytometry data |
| [`sw_unmix_pipeline()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix_pipeline) | End-to-end unmixing pipeline |
| [`sw_io_load_unmixed()`](unmix.qmd#sw_io_load_unmixed) | Load pre-unmixed FCS files |
| [`sw_filter_margins()`](unmix.qmd#sw_filter_margins) | Remove margin events |

|----------|-------------|

| [`sw_gate_run()`](gate.qmd#sw_gate_run) | Apply automated gating |
| [`sw_gate_extract()`](gate.qmd#sw_gate_extract) | Extract gated populations |

## Signal QC

Signal quality control with PeacoQC.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_qc_run()`](qc.qmd#sw_qc_run) | Signal QC on a single flowFrame |
| [`sw_qc_batch()`](qc.qmd#sw_qc_batch) | Batch signal QC |
| [`sw_qc_summary()`](qc.qmd#sw_qc_summary) | QC summary report |

## Batch correction

Batch correction with cyCombine, including all-in-one and modular workflows,
plus diagnostic evaluation and visualisation.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_correct_prepare()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_prepare) | Prepare data for batch correction |
| [`sw_correct_run()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_run) | All-in-one batch correction |
| [`sw_correct_normalize()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_normalize) | Normalise data (modular step 1) |
| [`sw_correct_som()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_som) | Create SOM clusters (modular step 2) |
| [`sw_correct_apply()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_apply) | Apply ComBat correction (modular step 3) |
| [`sw_correct_evaluate_quick()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_evaluate_quick) | Quick evaluation of correction quality |
| [`sw_correct_detect_batch()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_detect_batch) | Detect batch effects |
| [`sw_correct_emd()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_emd) | Compute Earth Mover's Distance |
| [`sw_correct_evaluate_emd()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_evaluate_emd) | Evaluate correction with EMD |
| [`sw_correct_evaluate_mad()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_evaluate_mad) | Evaluate correction with MAD |
| [`sw_plot_batch_densities()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_plot_batch_densities) | Plot marker density by batch |
| [`sw_plot_batch_dimred()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_plot_batch_dimred) | Plot dimensionality reduction by batch |

|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_cluster_run()`](cluster.qmd#sw_cluster_run) | Cluster cells using kohonen SOM or FastPG |
| [`sw_cluster_assignments()`](cluster.qmd#sw_cluster_assignments) | Get cluster assignments |
| [`sw_cluster_mfi()`](cluster.qmd#sw_cluster_mfi) | Compute MFIs per cluster |
| [`sw_plot_clusters()`](cluster.qmd#sw_plot_clusters) | Plot cluster heatmap |

## Composable pipeline

R7/S7-based composable pipeline framework for building custom workflows.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_pipeline_step()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step) | Create a processing step |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_run()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_run) | Execute a processing step |
| [`sw_pipeline()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline) | Create a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_add()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_add) | Add a step to a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_remove()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_remove) | Remove a step from a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_replace()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_replace) | Replace a step in a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_names()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_names) | Get step names |
| [`sw_pipeline_length()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_length) | Get number of steps |
| [`sw_pipeline_run()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_run) | Execute a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_concat()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_concat) | Concatenate two pipelines |
| [`sw_pipeline_show()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_show) | Print pipeline summary |
| [`sw_plot_pipeline()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_plot_pipeline) | Plot pipeline flowchart |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_read_fcs()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_read_fcs) | Step: read FCS files |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_filter_margins()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_filter_margins) | Step: remove margin events |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_qc()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_qc) | Step: signal QC |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_correct()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_correct) | Step: batch correction |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_normalize()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_normalize) | Step: normalisation |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_som()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_som) | Step: SOM clustering |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_correct_apply()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_correct_apply) | Step: ComBat correction |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_cluster()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_cluster) | Step: clustering |
